verification_adapter_note: For this strictly loopback-only INC-09B implementation, mock_server.py's /_mock/pec/native_calculation response carries an `expected` FinancialSummary (all nine fields) and a `calculation_version`, computed with exact Decimal/HALF_UP arithmetic -- this arithmetic relating the nine fields is ITSELF mock-only/unconfirmed, never claimed as the real portal's formula. VerifiedMissionWriter.verify_financial_summary() compares that `expected` value against an INDEPENDENT, later, fresh DOM read (never the same value read twice). A non-loopback/live version of this mechanism does not exist and is not implemented -- mcma.portal.writer._require_loopback_host structurally refuses any non-loopback allowed_host before a browser is ever created, so this code cannot run against a real portal host at all. Live selector/readiness/response-contract confirmation for the seven mock_only fields remains a G5 blocker.
